title: Defender Greataxe

sources.title: Defensive Attack
markers: | summary = '''Defensive Attack''' is a passive feature/reaction that lets the wielder of {{SmRarityItem|Defender Greataxe}} temporarily sacrifice one [[Enchantment]] level from the axe to gain +1 bonus AC and saving throws. This choice is given when making the first attack with the axe in a round.

fields.Defensive Attack: Optional Reaction on the first attack you make with this weapon each round. Reduce the weapon enchantment by 1 and gain +1 AC and saving throws for 1 turn. The attack penalty applies to the triggering roll.
fields.Base value: 380 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
